record.notes: Adopted at the Ministerial and High Authorities Summit in Santiago, 23-24 Oct 2023. The Spanish text does not list the signatory countries; Chile's investment promotion agency (InvestChile) reports that 20 Latin American and Caribbean nations signed. The second summit (Montevideo, 3-4 Oct 2024) adopted the Montevideo Declaration, recorded as INT-17.

original_title.quote: “Para promover una inteligencia artificial ética en América Latina y el Caribe”

title.quote: Santiago Declaration to Promote Ethical Artificial Intelligence in Latin America and the Caribbean

date_published.quote: Santiago de Chile, 23-24 de octubre de 2023

status.quote: Las Ministras, Ministros y Altas Autoridades representantes de los países de América Latina y el Caribe

legal_force.quote: 2. Que los países aquí firmantes acuerdan iniciar un análisis

issuing_body.quote: Cumbre Ministerial y de Altas Autoridades de América Latina y el Caribe

notes.quote: In a historic meeting at La Moneda Palace, 20 Latin American and Caribbean nations came together to sign the Santiago Declaration

changes.notes: The Montevideo follow-up declaration (3-4 Oct 2024) is now stored and recorded as INT-17, so the "reportedly" wording is stale; the Chilean government investment agency says 20 nations signed.

judgment.status_reasoning: Adopted Oct 2023; no amendment. English title matches InvestChile rendering (agency page, not the issuer text), so title is a rendering; english_version stays none found.
